title: French Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful French-inspired noodle stir fry made with egg noodles and your choice of vivid and malaysian ingredients.
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the vivid and malaysian ingredients and cook until they start to soften.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
Add a bit more oil if necessary, then pour in the beaten egg.
Scramble the egg until it's cooked through, then mix it with the vegetables.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine.
